description: Row-level copper stage labels derived from bronze_continuous using DS copper provisional, confirmed, and contextual expansion algorithms.
sql: SELECT CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS telemetry_point_id, fleet_name, pad_name, name AS well_name, id AS well_id, api_num, record_ts, created_ts, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS bronze_continuous, CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS copper_provisional, CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS copper_confirmed, CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS copper_continuous, CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS stage_num, rate_slurry, press_mainline, prop_conc_blend_denso, prop_conc_blend_auger, prop_conc_inline, prop_conc_target, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS algorithm_version, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS source_mode, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS processed_at FROM datastore:merged_fleet_stream_customer_full_v2 WHERE 1 = 0
